description: T7-1 (docs/test-campaigns/phase-12.md): the walker switches to the only form of Parser.parse that accepts a progress_callback (a read callback), which is how ADR-0027's 'cooperatively cancellable parser' would have to be built on py-tree-sitter 0.25. Single-threaded it parses identically. But Python now runs mid-parse, so the GIL can pass to another thread that enters the same get_parser() singleton. Threads then overlap inside the non-reentrant C parser: the process crashes or the trees come back wrong.

target.replace:
tree = parser.parse(
                    lambda byte, _point: content[byte : byte + 65536],
                    progress_callback=lambda _offset, _has_error: False,
                )
